services.desc: Artist and Juror Reception: Tuesday, December 8, 2026, 5 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. Jurors’ Talks and Awards Presentation at 6:30 p.m. The 2026 Statewide Annual (SWA) will be exhibited at The Utah Valley University Museum of Art at Lakemount in Orem, UT and composed of artworks in the categories of mixed media, works on paper, and installation, selected from artists’ submissions from across the state. We are honored to have Lehuauakea (Hawaii/New Mexico) and Liz Miller (Minnesota) as this year’s jurors, as they bring a vast array of knowledge to the selection process. Artwork submissions must follow the theme of this year’s exhibition: Mixed Media, Works on Paper, and Installation AI Note:
